name: General Bytes
rootCause: According to the official Twitter, the General Bytes encrypted currency ATM service was attacked on March 17 and 18. The attacker used the upload interface in the system to upload and run a malicious Java program, and then the attacker obtained the permissions of the database in the server and Hot wallet withdrawal API Key. According to SlowMist MistTrack, the loss was about $1.8 million.

descriptions.text: According to the official Twitter, the General Bytes encrypted currency ATM service was attacked on March 17 and 18. The attacker used the upload interface in the system to upload and run a malicious Java program, and then the attacker obtained the permissions of the database in the server and Hot wallet withdrawal API Key. According to SlowMist MistTrack, the loss was about $1.8 million.

General Bytes' Bitcoin ATM cloud and standalone servers were breached on March 17-18, 2023. Attackers exploited a master service interface to deploy malicious software, accessing databases, hot wallets, and user credentials, resulting in theft of at least 56 BTC and additional assets. A vulnerability in the master service interface allowed remote file upload without proper access control, enabling attackers to execute malicious applications on ATM servers with BATM user privileges.
